item.description:

A new study from Global Energy Monitor counted 189 gigawatts of gas-fired capacity in development in the first half of 2026. But it remains unclear if all of those plants will ultimately be built, since most projects are in early development and the demand surge has led to a bottleneck for gas turbines, with some suppliers warning of yearslong lead times. Dean stayed out of the spotlight, and Parton addressed conspiracy theories that he didn't exist. Dean died on March 3, 2025, at the age of 82. Parton died on Tuesday at age 80. Carl Dean , Dolly Parton's husband of nearly six decades, inspired some of Parton's most successful songs — even though they were rarely seen together.
